headline: Public hearings on four zoning requests, including a home food kitchen at 8 Oxbow Ln and a subdivision at 73 Goodhue Rd.
summary: Two requests ask for variances from setback and wetland rules. The subdivision would sit in both Derry and Windham, and the food kitchen needs a special exception.
items: Home-based food production kitchen in an accessory structure, 8 Oxbow Ln (special exception)
12-by-24-foot addition less than 75 feet from a wetland, 22 Lampton Dr (variance)
10-by-15-foot shed 10 feet from side and rear property lines, 14 Derryfield Rd (variance)
Two-lot subdivision in Derry and Windham, 73 Goodhue Rd (variance)
plain_text:
ZONING BOARD OF ADJUSTMENT – AGENDA 
December 3, 2026 
 
LIVE  
 
Zoom Link 
URL: https://zoom.us/j/323909140    
Enter Meeting ID: 323909140 
 
 
PUBLIC HEARING: 
 
26-135 
Applicant: Angela Pacheco 
Owner: Michael & Angela Pacheco 
Parcel ID 04024-025 
  8 Oxbow Ln 
Zoned:  LDR 
 
The applicant is requesting a Special Exception to the terms of Article VI, Section 165-48.A.1 of the 
Town of Derry Zoning Ordinance to allow a home-based food production kitchen within an accessory 
structure on the property.  
 
 
26-136 
Applicant: Jeffrey Wright 
Owner: Jeffrey & Rachael Wright 
Parcel ID 06046-041 
  22 Lampton Dr. 
Zoned:  LMDR 
 
The applicant is requesting a variance to the terms of Article III, Section 165-20.a of the Town of Derry 
Zoning Ordinance to allow the construction of a 12 foot by 24 foot addition less than 75 feet from a 
wetland greater than 1 acre.  
 
 
26-137 
Applicant: Christopher McCall 
Owner: Erica & Christopher McCall 
Parcel ID 21016 
  14 Derryfield Rd 
Zoned:  MDR 
 
The applicant is requesting a variance to the terms of Article VI, Section 165-48.C.4 of the Town of 
Derry Zoning Ordinance to allow the construction of a 10’ x 15’ shed 10 feet from the side and rear 
property lines where a 15 foot setback is required.
26-138 
Applicant: Samuel Forgue 
Owner: Normandin Family Living Trust 
Parcel ID 04014-001 
  73 Goodhue Rd 
Zoned:  LDR 
 
The applicant is requesting a variance to the terms of Article VI, Section 165-48.B.1 & 2 of the Town of 
Derry Zoning Ordinance to allow a 2-lot subdivision of the property which is located in both the Town 
of Derry and the Town of Windham. The proposed lots will have less than the required frontage and lot 
area located in the Town of Derry. 
 
OTHER BUSINESS 
 
CORRESPONDENCE  Town and City Publication 
 
APPROV AL OF MINUTES  11/19/26 
 
ADJOURN
